problem: The property has no sh:minCount, so a ship with no daily low-temperature observation nodes can conform despite the requirement requiring the daily observation dataset as an input.
required_change: Add sh:minCount 1 to nltl:hasDailyLowTemperatureObservation while retaining the nested observation constraints.
regression_guard: Preserve the requirement that each ship provides at least one dated daily low-temperature observation carrying a daily low-temperature quantity.
